resources.string: Two buttons for fold toggle and dual-screen mode.
For Cover Screen: Fold toggle, dual-screen mode, one-key cast, adaptive rotation.
3-reel lever lottery score, tap counter to switch to three quick action buttons.
For Cover Screen: Lottery score, tap counter to switch to three quick buttons.
Pull the lever on the right to spin
Tap cell to use function, tap lever for settings.
Each of the three slots corresponds to a toggle action.
For Cover Screen: Four buttons corresponding to user actions.
Four buttons corresponding to four actions, tap cell to set up.

Adaptive rotation automatically rotates inner screen orientation based on application landscape/portrait state, designed for handheld portable monitors.\n\nThe display may shift by 90 degrees; do not enable for fixed-orientation monitors.
For Cover Screen: Battery, CPU temperature, RAM and storage usage.
App launcher for cover screen: Icon grid, tap to open on that screen
No applications selected Tap gear in top bar to select
Remove all selected applications from the launcher?

Detected an existing cover screen app list in the system (%1$d apps), import it?
Importing will overwrite currently selected content.
No list found to import. System cover launcher widget may not have been used on this device.
Failed to read list. Please check Shizuku authorization.
Failed to read image. Please select another image.
Tap icon to show/hide, long press to favorite/uninstall, drag to reorder.
Showing favorites only. Long press icon to favorite/uninstall, drag to reorder.
Uninstalling will also clear records in launcher and favorites.
Shizuku permission required to uninstall apps
Invalid package name, command not executed.
Release to place, drags to end auto-scroll.
Sorting unavailable while searching. Clear search box before dragging.
Import existing list from system, overwriting current selection.
Write current selection order to secondary launcher once. After writing, both remain independent.
Exported order of %1$d apps to secondary launcher.
No applications selected, nothing to export.
Secondary launcher has no custom order yet. Set order in Cover Launcher first, then use "Import → Export order to secondary launcher".
Rotates external screen following phone's actual orientation, removing black borders after rotation.\n\nRequires Shizuku authorization.

Determines screen to light up on boot according to fold state; "Not set" delegates to fold sensor.
Note: Shizuku must be ready at boot time.

Lock display orientation of phone's inner screen.
Note: Re-enabling auto-rotation in system quick settings will automatically sync back to auto mode.
External screen ignores app requested orientation and rotates only according to phone's actual orientation.\n\nAvailable only when phone orientation is locked.

Tap 0° / 90° / 180° / 270° one by one to see which orientation is upright, then enter it into "Portrait lock to / Landscape lock to" above.\n\n"Restore system auto-rotation" hands external display control back to system.
Tap to immediately restore when external display content is offset with only a corner visible.

Modify inner screen resolution to match inner/outer screen aspect ratio and avoid black borders or stretching.
Enter as "Width × Height". Leave DPI blank or 0 for no change.
Note: If SecondScreen or similar apps are installed, switch to manual mode. Simultaneous modifications cause misalignment.

Set upper/lower bounds for inner screen refresh rate instead of system adaptive; identical values lock rate.
Note: Rates above 60Hz require identifying inner screen; closed cover screen only supports 60Hz.
Read native pixel count of external screen panel, convert to portrait and fill into inputs above automatically.
Resolution set via "Apply Now" persists across unplugging and reboot; set via connection prompt restores on unplug.
Change phone fold/unfold state, requires Shizuku permission.
Some features require adb or root permissions. adb permission provided via Shizuku: authorize this app in Shizuku and keep it running.
When root (KernelSU / Magisk) is present, tap "Root Authorization" and allow in popup to run commands as root. Absence of root does not affect other features.
Current values for screen parameters and app permissions.

Switch to inner/outer dual-screen concurrency and project secondary launcher on cover screen. Tap icon to open app on that screen.
Requires Shizuku permission.

An app grid on cover screen, tap icon to open directly on cover screen without unfolding phone.
Note: Launching and uninstalling apps require Shizuku permission.

Config page for Cover Launcher: Select apps, adjust order and appearance, changes sync to cover screen grid.
Note: Uninstalling apps requires Shizuku permission.

This widget needs to be pinned on cover screen manually.

Go to "Settings → Cover Screen", check "Cover Launcher" (or "Widgets"), fold phone and swipe to widgets page on cover screen; if missing, tap "+" on page, select from list and place on page.

Needs to be pinned only once. Selecting or deselecting apps in config page auto-updates grid afterwards.

Remember parameters for each external monitor by screen identity, auto-applying next time screen is recognized.
Note: "Orientation Sync", "Auto Rotation", "Prompt on Connect", and "Auto Restore on Unplug" are recorded globally, not saved per screen.

Experimental features gathered here centered around cover screen; details subject to change, most require Shizuku permission.\n\nSecondary screen and dual-screen items moved to main tab "Dual Screen".

Project secondary launcher (full app grid) to cover screen without toggling dual-screen mode.
Requires Shizuku permission.

Open DeX desktop on portable display.
Note: · Triggering requires root; without root only incomplete desktop is launched. · Phone inner and cover screens turn off automatically after launch.
Force override resolution, DPI and display orientation of cover screen.\n\nNote: Deviating significantly from panel native values causes stretching or cropping.
Logical resolution and DPI of cover screen. Enter numbers for width/height; leave DPI blank for no change.\n\nScreen flickering upon application is normal.
Save frequent resolutions as presets. Tap a row to apply parameters, long press to delete, top-right to add or restore factory presets.\n\nStores up to 12 presets.
Force rotate cover screen to specified orientation.\n\n"Rotate 90°" cycles through 0°, 90°, 180°, 270°; "Cancel Fixed Angle" releases locked angle back to system decision.

Cover screen content automatically rotates following gravity orientation.
Note: Requires Shizuku and accessibility permissions.
Connect physical keys and custom commands here. Select key and action, then tap card button to complete setup in system.\n\nCustom commands maintained in card below.

Bind actions to power and volume keys.
Note: · Power key uses system "Digital Assistant" slot, replacing original item. · Volume keys require accessibility service running.
Saved commands appear in action list for "Side Key Actions", bindable to keys.\n\nNote: Commands run as shell identity; scope depends on Shizuku permissions.
Fill action column with action below, parameter column with action_key.\n\nBuilt-in actions listed below; custom commands filled as custom:<id>, id shown on right of command name.

Extend app content into safe area around camera cutout, removing system black borders.
Tap once to apply to all installed apps. Takes 10-20 seconds with many apps; requires relaunching apps to take effect.
Note: Executed via Shizuku; OS updates may invalidate changes.

Swipe up from bottom center of cover screen when closed, pause to open recents; release directly to go home.
Requires accessibility service running.

Panel contents keep rows checked in order consistent with four lines.
Note: · Notifications require separate "Notification Access" permission, independent of accessibility. · Requires accessibility service running.

In checked apps, bottom swipe is split into two steps: swipe near center to call out light bar, then swipe from light bar, avoiding game mis-touches.
Light bar auto-retracts after 3s without operation.

Slide inward from left/right edges to go back, swipe up from bottom for home, swipe & pause for recents.
Note: · Bottom left and right corners ignore gestures in landscape mode to prevent palm mis-touches during gaming. · Requires accessibility service running.

Hide 3-button navigation bar on desktop and cover screen, dedicating screen bottom to full-screen gestures.
Note: · Written to system settings via Shizuku. · If Good Lock is installed, disable "Show and hide buttons" in NavStar first to avoid override.
Switch to Fold and return to Cover Home
When enabled, long press volume up or down keys to execute cover screen quick actions.

Determines which pseudo-apps appear on secondary launcher.\n\nPseudo-apps are built-in pages, not real system apps, pinned to front of secondary launcher grid; absent from system app list, cover launcher, and search page.
Real-time status panel on cover screen displaying CPU usage, temperature, RAM and cluster frequencies. Screen remains on, no Shizuku required.
Plays songs on phone to auto-display here.
Requires "Notification Access" to read media information.
Unable to read screen info. Confirm Shizuku is running and authorized.
Target screen is current screen, command not executed.
Slide to move cursor, cursor appears on inner screen.
Unable to read inner screen info. Confirm Shizuku is running.
Missing "Display over other apps" permission; cursor cannot be shown.
Cursor creation failed. Check overlay permission or try again later.
Note: Touches using slow input path. Enable accessibility service or Shizuku for responsive tracking.
Find "Adaptive Screen++" in accessibility settings and turn on switch.
Slide to move cursor, light tap to click, hold to long press, hold and slide to drag, 2-finger vertical to scroll, 2-finger horizontal to flip page.
"Reset Inner Resolution" takes effect on next cast session.
Tap "Start Casting" to view inner screen here
Unable to read inner screen info. Confirm Shizuku is running.
Shizuku authorization required to acquire inner screen dimensions.
Shizuku not connected. System authorization popup cannot be clicked on cover screen. Please unfold phone and tap "Start Casting" on inner screen.
Screen cast authorization canceled or denied.
Note: Screen cast is black when inner screen is off. Unfold phone first.
Click and drag directly on image; enable "Allow Pinch Zoom" for 2-finger scaling.

Operate inner screen while folded or using this screen: image casts here with direct tap/drag.
Tap "Start Casting" after connecting Shizuku; "Full Screen" requires checking "Reset Inner Resolution" to fill screen.
Note: · Screen cast permission required each session. · Cast image is black when inner screen is off. · If app is force closed, manually restore resolution in "Inner Screen Resolution" tab on main screen.
Tap input field on inner screen first, then type here
Enter text to send to inner screen.

Use cover screen as laptop touchpad, cursor shown on target screen.
Tap to click, hold to long press, hold & slide to drag, 2-finger vertical slide to scroll, 2-finger horizontal slide to flip page.

Cursor is an overlay floating window on inner screen, requiring "Display over other apps" permission.

Path: Settings → Apps → This App → Display over other apps.

Page can be entered without permission, but cursor will not be visible.

Type on cover screen to send text to inner screen focused cursor position.
Tap input field on inner screen first, then type here and tap "Send".
Note: Input fields without focus on inner screen will not receive text.

When connecting to new Wi-Fi, open wireless debugging via this button. Requires accessibility permission.
Note: Screen may turn black for two seconds when using this feature.

One-step execution of "Start Dual-Screen Mode → Screen Cast Control → Full Screen → Start Casting".
Note: Switches to dual-screen mode, altering inner screen target point.
Render app on cover screen at native dimensions: normal fonts, popups within screen bounds and clickable.

Checked apps render on cover screen at native dimensions.
Note: Modifies Samsung's system list (Settings → Cover Screen → Apps allowed on cover screen), not this app's settings.
